title: Weird websites quiz
fullTitle: Why Do Websites Do Weird Things? The Five-Question Quiz

scenes.narration: Five weird website moments, five questions. Every answer comes from a test in the open repository, using made-up people and made-up data. Let's see how you do.
captions: Five weird website moments. Five questions.
Every answer comes from a test in the repository.

scenes.narration: Question one. Someone taps Pay once. The shop saves the order, but the reply is lost, so the app retries with the same ticket number. How many orders exist afterwards? A, one. B, two. C, three.
captions: Q1. Pay tapped once, reply lost, retry with the same ticket number.
How many orders exist afterwards? A: one. B: two. C: three.

scenes.narration: A, one. The server saw the same ticket number and returned the saved order. Without the ticket, the same test made two orders. That is Episode fifteen.
captions: A: one order. The same ticket returns the saved order.
Without a ticket, the same test made two. Episode 15.

scenes.narration: Question two. A new version of the site is published, but your open tab still shows Build one. In our model, what happens to Build two? A, it replaces Build one at once. B, it installs and waits. C, it is deleted.
captions: Q2. New version published, open tab still shows Build 1.
What happens to Build 2? A: replaces at once. B: installs and waits. C: deleted.

scenes.narration: B, it installs and waits. The old version keeps control of the open page until the new one is allowed to take over. This is a model, not a browser recording. Episode twelve.
captions: B: it installs and waits behind Build 1.
A model, not a browser recording. Episode 12.

scenes.narration: Question three. Alice loads her dashboard. Then Bob loads his. In the flawed test, what does Bob see? A, Welcome back, Bob. B, an error page. C, Welcome back, Alice.
captions: Q3. Alice loads her dashboard, then Bob loads his.
In the flawed test, what does Bob see? A: Bob. B: error. C: Alice.

scenes.narration: C, Welcome back, Alice. The saved page was filed under just the path, with no person in the label. Episode twenty four.
captions: C: Welcome back, Alice.
The saved page had no person in its label. Episode 24.

scenes.narration: Question four. A deadline is the calendar date January fifteenth. The flawed page shows it on a New York clock. Which date appears? A, January fifteenth. B, January sixteenth. C, January fourteenth.
captions: Q4. A deadline of January 15 shown on a New York clock.
Which date appears? A: Jan 15. B: Jan 16. C: Jan 14.

scenes.narration: C, January fourteenth. The date was read as midnight in London, which is seven in the evening the day before in New York. Episode twenty two.
captions: C: January 14. Midnight in London is 7 pm the day before in New York.
Episode 22.

scenes.narration: Question five. We delete contact one zero zero three. A direct lookup says not found. In the flawed version, what does a search for Dana return? A, the contact is still listed. B, nothing. C, an error.
captions: Q5. Contact c_1003 deleted. A direct lookup says not found.
A search for Dana returns? A: still listed. B: nothing. C: an error.

scenes.narration: A, the contact is still listed. The delete removed the main record, but the search copy stayed. Episode twenty one.
captions: A: the contact is still listed.
The delete removed only the main record. Episode 21.
